object.attr: analysis: deleting an attribute removes a value from each such object (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-98). Undo brings the values back only until the next commit or reload, so the user must see the size of the change first.
object.description: When the user deletes an attribute that one or more objects have a value for, the Properties dialog shall first show how many objects have a value and ask the user to confirm.
